metadata.description: Tobias Schlitt's Claude Code plugins, starting with the tce context-engineering workflow.

plugins.name: tce
plugins.description: Context-engineering workflow: ticket → research → plan → implement, plus review/discuss/design commands and research agents. Authors tickets (/tce:ticket) and works with any ticket system (tmt, GitHub, Jira, Linear, …).

plugins.name: tmt
plugins.description: Toby Markdown Tickets: lightweight Git-tracked ticket tracker — tickets as markdown files in your repo, owning the envelope (sequential numbering, status-lifecycle hooks, create/update). tce's native ticket backend.
